visibleResult: Each Home screen shows the Ultimate Lemmix logo, Classic 0/3 starter entry, Start Journey and content import controls. iPhone uses its actual scrolling layout; iPad and TV show their wider layouts.
candidateType: Clean Debug simulator builds from the current source; not physical-device Release binaries.
proofSetup: Separate integration-tests bundle identifiers. Hosted endpoint keys removed and cloud flags disabled in proof copies. Welcome flags acknowledged only in each isolated test app container.

diagnostics.externalInjection: The first injected launch waited in dyld while opening the capture library on the external volume. The stack sample is retained.
diagnostics.localInjection: The /tmp library loaded, but the helper produced no ready receipt. It enumerates UIWindowScene while this product uses a legacy UIWindow. Final captures used no injected library.
diagnostics.productStartup: Uninjected app launches reached Home on all three platforms. No product startup blocker reproduced.

limits: Home presentation only; no gameplay, touch, controller or focus-navigation acceptance.
Physical devices, hosted services and release-signed binary runtime were not exercised.
No broad test suites or App Store uploads were run.
These are actual screenshots without resizing, artwork replacement or added marketing text.
